mentions.name: ZapLearner
mentions.description: This website helps kids practice reading comprehension and learn new words through daily global news articles, keeping them up to date with current events. It includes gamified features like streaks and badges, which were suggested by the builder's own kids.
mentions.problem: Helps kids maintain their reading skills; originally built so the builder's own kids could keep practicing reading while the family travels.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a website where kids can practice reading comprehension and learn new words while staying up to date with the latest global news each day.

evidence.value: I built a website where kids can practice reading comprehension and learn new words while staying up to date with the latest global news each day.
